title: Your inventory system
for electronics.
hero.summary: Free, open-source and terminal based. Purpose-built for electronics.

lines: You just scan a label and the system handels the rest.

steps.title: Import a whole order
steps.text: Load a DigiKey order CSV and review it line by line: accept or skip each part, and Inventatory creates the accepted ones and fills in their details from DigiKey.

steps.title: Know precisely where your parts are
steps.text: Inventatory features 3D-Printable racks. The system automatically assigns each part to a specific slot on the rack, so later it can give you the precise location of it, not just generic 'Drawer 12'.

steps.title: Build a board
steps.text: Import your PCBs BOM and Inventatory will automatically display on which rack and slot each of the part is stored.

steps.title: Undo anything
steps.text: Every change to your stock is recorded. See exactly what changed, set checkpoints, and restore or reverse a change, even after a restart.

scanner.title: Inventatory Scan R1
scanner.summary: A custom, DiY-able hardware scanner that's directly integrated with Inventatory. It can read vendor labels, modify your stock and print labels for new parts automatically.

open.title: Build it yourself
open.text: The firmware, schematics and instructions that are needed to build the scanner are open-source and available for free. You can design and print your own enclosure.

bundle.title: Pre-designed CAD bundle
bundle.text: If you don't feel like designing it yourself, this bundle includes ready to use .STEP and .3MF files for the enclosure and charging dock for the scanner. Your purchase supports my projects, thank you!
